summary: v32.0.0-alpha.59 verification complete. All spec items PASS: (FIX 2) sections-list returns 10 sections including host+location; fetch-section/host returns 1 slide with image element (data:image/jpeg;base64 src); (FIX 2b) 6/6 alpha59 pytests pass; (FIX 1) /app/backend/seed_covers ships all 7 required files (1960s/1970s/1980s/Music/Sports/mc_title jpgs 135-357KB, times_up.gif 2.1MB) — all >100KB; (FEATURE 3) overlay round-type tag chips render for overlay 17a48134 (data-testid overlay-round-tags-{imageId} + overlay-tag-{imageId}-{RT}) with MC+BIG initially active (yellow rgba(244,196,48,0.18)) and REG/MISC/MYS inactive (dark). Clicking REG chip shows success toast 'Overlay shows on: MC, BIG, REG', PATCH request returns 200 with updated applies_to_round_types, chip turns active. Regression: 34/34 pytests pass (alpha54=7, alpha55=12, alpha56=5, alpha58=4, alpha59=6). Health 200. fetch-section round_2 still returns _title_card_source='bighat-embedded-cover'. Frontend login and Admin > Trivia Setup UI works.

critical_code_review_comments: OverlayRoundTags contract (TriviaSetup.jsx L629-682) correctly handles legacy untagged=null showing all 5 as effective active. Toggling from ALL-active removes the clicked chip and PATCHes the remaining 4 explicitly (making the array explicit) — user intent preserved.

seed_covers directory well-sized (~4MB total) — reasonable bundle size for a Tauri sidecar. No <100B placeholders detected.
